brand.name: learntolarp.com
brand.positioning: AI-generated intelligence briefing tool disguised as a tongue-in-cheek infiltration guide. 70% real utility, 30% joke/gimmick. Designed for ages 13-17 with a Discord/gaming culture register.

display.usage: Entity titles, Larpability score, main hero headlines, section tier badges

body.usage: Main briefing text, culture notes, conversation starters, public perception copy

mono.usage: Metadata, timestamps, citation tags, form-field labels, redacted state text, status counters

1_hero_and_larpability_score.concept: Iconic gaming-tier focal point + intelligence file header. The score is the ONE bold visual moment.
1_hero_and_larpability_score.layout: Flex/Grid split header. Left side: Title, entity type badge, trending signal, 1-line hook. Right side: Giant Larpability Score stamp badge with rank letter (S/A/B/C) and difficulty tag.
1_hero_and_larpability_score.styling: Card background #FFFFFF with hard 2px border #0F172A, subtle bottom-right shadow-md offset, bold red stamp badge for S-tier/critical score.

2_five_second_briefing.concept: Instant catch-up quote box for quick skimming before entering a Discord call.
2_five_second_briefing.layout: Full-width banner with left thick 4px stamp-red edge accent.
2_five_second_briefing.styling: Background #FEF2F2 with text #0F172A, font-medium, leading-relaxed, labeled with '5-SECOND BRIEFING // TL;DR'.

3_know_this_fact.concept: Form-field / Database record look (Verifiable, sourced objective facts).
3_know_this_fact.layout: Grid of key-value data fields with subtle horizontal border divisions and source links.
3_know_this_fact.styling: Monospace uppercase labels ('[DATA_FIELD_01]', '[SOURCE_REF]'), crisp white containers with #E2DDD4 inner borders, verified checkmark badges.

4_know_this_culture.concept: Discord chat / community lore notebook (Heavier visual weight than FACT - this is the differentiator).
4_know_this_culture.layout: Asymmetrical callout cards with quote bubbles, insider jargon badges, and meme etiquette warnings.
4_know_this_culture.styling: Slightly tinted background #EEF2FF or #FAF8F5 with subtle border #C7D2FE, high visual emphasis on insider slang highlights ('MUST SAY', 'NEVER SAY').

5_infiltration_briefing_quotes.concept: Audio transcript style (3-5 real cited quotes with reason for context).
5_infiltration_briefing_quotes.layout: Vertical transcript stream with speaker avatars/monograms, timestamps, quote blocks, and context tag.
5_infiltration_briefing_quotes.styling: Monospace headers, subtle waveform/mic icon indicator, dark slate left border for speaker blocks.

6_public_perception.concept: Dual-meter visual gauge comparing 'Fans Say' vs 'Critics Say'.
6_public_perception.layout: Split comparison container with progress bars and side-by-side sentiment summary cards.
6_public_perception.styling: Emerald bar for fans ('CULT FOLLOWING'), Amber/Red bar for critics ('GATEKEEPERS').

7_latest_news.concept: Curated recent activity feed or honest 'quiet on the front' zero-state.
7_latest_news.layout: News card list with date tags, link icons, or radar search empty state card.
7_latest_news.styling: Clean card items with hover highlight #FAF8F5 and external link indicator.

8_conversation_starters.concept: 3-Tier interactive difficulty stack: Safe, Medium, Risky.
8_conversation_starters.layout: Stacked collapsible/accordion or card grid categorized by risk tier, with a 'Copy to Clipboard' quick action button for each starter.
8_conversation_starters.styling: Safe (Green badge/border), Medium (Amber badge/border), Risky (Red stamp badge/border).

9_cross_references.concept: Linked entities network with active cards & redacted/locked states for ungenerated entities.
9_cross_references.layout: Grid of entity pills/cards. Ungenerated items are redacted ([REDACTED - CLICK TO QUEUE]).
9_cross_references.styling: Active items: interactive link cards with arrow. Ungenerated items: dark slate bar with redacted black bars, clicking opens/queues generator.

10_export_cheat_sheet.concept: Viral mechanic: Modal and card to generate PNG image + copyable text cheat sheet for Discord/Twitter sharing.
10_export_cheat_sheet.layout: Sticky CTA bar or prominent action button opening a high-density compact cheat sheet card preview.
10_export_cheat_sheet.styling: High-contrast card frame ready for html2canvas / PNG export, button with download icon and copy text action.

11_landing_page.concept: High-energy search portal with instant autocomplete & trending/recently-infiltrated entities grid.
11_landing_page.layout: Hero search box at top with category pills (Anime, Gaming, Music, Pop Culture, Web3, Internet Lore) + bento grid of trending entity cards.
11_landing_page.styling: Big bold search input with keyboard shortcut hint ('Press / to search'), animated 'Generating Case File...' modal when searching a new entity.

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Do NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk for headings
Do NOT use ALL CAPS decorative labels on every card
Do NOT use 'WORD — fragment' eyebrow text with spaced em-dashes
Do NOT join metadata with middle-dots ('A · B · C')
Do NOT put arrows (→) on every single button
Do NOT use uniform hover-lift on every card — make interactions feel specific
Do NOT use dark mode neon glow or heavy militaristic stencil fonts
Do NOT use emoji characters as UI icons
Do NOT use fully transparent header backgrounds that obscure text on scroll

accessibility_and_code.tech_stack: React (JavaScript .js/.jsx files), Tailwind CSS, Lucide React Icons, Sonner for toasts
accessibility_and_code.color_contrast: All body text minimum 4.5:1 against #F7F4EE and #FFFFFF backgrounds. Primary text #0F172A.
accessibility_and_code.keyboard_navigation: Focus rings must use outline-2 outline-indigo-600 offset-2

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use .js / .jsx file extensions.
Ensure all interactive elements and data fields include explicit data-testid attributes listed in guidelines.
Implement both Landing Page route ('/') and Entity Page route ('/entity/:id' or search result).
Make sure the 10 core entity sections look visually and structurally distinct from each other as specified.
Integrate Sonner for toast notifications when copying conversation starters or cheat sheets.
Provide a smooth initial search experience with mock AI generator state when generating a brand new case file.
